question: Which gas is primarily produced during the burning of coke?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Carbon dioxide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Carbon dioxide (CO₂)** is primarily produced during the burning of coke because coke is primarily composed of **carbon**.
 
• When coke burns in the presence of oxygen, it undergoes a chemical reaction known as **combustion**, which releases **carbon dioxide** and energy.
 
• The chemical reaction for the combustion of coke is: C + O
